AGENDA

OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Creation of the Butcher Solana Ad Hoc Committee and Palos Verdes Estates Foundation Ad Hoc Committee and the Appointments of City Councilmembers to these Committees
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Appointments of City Councilmembers to these Committees.

Staff Report
5.
Affirmation of Opposition to Senate Bill 50 (Wiener) – Planning and Zoning and Housing Development Incentives as Amended on May 1, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council oppose SB 50 and authorize the Mayor a letter of opposition and authorize staff to disseminate it to all appropriate parties.
Staff Report
6.
Special Event Application and Request to Post Signs for the Malaga Cove Business and Professional Association’s “Malaga Cove Concerts in the Park” at Farnham Martin Park
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council approve the Special Event Application and request to post signs for the annual “Malaga Cove Concerts in the Park” at Farnham Martin Park on Wednesdays, July 10th, July 17th, July 24th, July 31st, August 7th, August 14th, August 21st, and August 28th, 2019 and approve the posting of promotional signs for each concert at both permitted locations one week prior to the event.
Staff Report
7.
Affirmation Of Opposition To Senate Bill 542 (Stern) –Workers’ Compensation Post Traumatic Stress Disorder Presumption
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council go on record opposing Senate Bill 542 (SB 542) and authorize the Mayor to sign a letter of opposition and authorize staff to disseminate it to all appropriate parties.
Staff Report
8.
Planning Commission Actions of May 21, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council Receive and file the Planning Commission Actions of May 21, 2019.
Staff Report
9.
Resolution R19-17; Approving the Special Tax Report and Setting the PVE Law Enforcement Special Tax Levy for FY 2019/20
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R19-17; approving the Special Tax Report and establishing the FY 2019/20 PVE Law Enforcement Tax special tax levy in conformance with Measure E and submit the special tax to Los Angeles County by the August 2019 deadline to record it on the property tax bills.
Staff Report

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the information.

Discussion on Local Regulation of Accessory Dwelling Units and Provisions for Junior Accessory Dwelling Units
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for local control of accessory dwelling units and provisions for junior accessory dwelling units and direct staff to prepare an ordinance addressing ADUs and JADUs for City Council consideration.
